title: We Bring the Boom
blurb: An announcement rather than a warning, and the distinction matters. Whatever is about to happen has already been decided, the paperwork is filed, and you are being informed as a courtesy. That total absence of doubt makes the clip enormously useful in edits, because it front-loads the confidence so the footage does not have to earn it. Play it before entrances, before plot twists, before any moment where the energy in a room is about to change permanently. Nobody who says this sentence has ever been talked out of anything.
